structural.name: Open decision · nav grouping
structural.text: OPEN DECISION — group names and membership. UX-I-37 asks for the groups to be renamed into the user’s vocabulary and for two rows to move: “PLUMBING” is an implementer’s word, Analytics is not distribution and Forms is not plumbing. Proposed: SITE (General, Branding, SEO, Canvas) · PUBLISHING (Export, Domains, Redirects, Localization) · VISITORS (Analytics, Forms) · ADVANCED (Custom code, Headers, Integrations, Webhooks) · WORKSPACE ↗ (Members, Billing). Drawn, not applied — renaming a group also rewrites the breadcrumb on 30 section boards, so it lands as one decision or none.
structural.why: UX-I-37 (Major) — group rename is a founder-level naming call and it invalidates 30 breadcrumbs; drawn as an open decision rather than half-applied

structural.name: Notice · SEO is edited in two places
structural.text: SEO is edited in two places and neither names the other. This screen sets the site-level title template, Twitter handle and default OG image (SeoScreen.tsx:76-141); each page’s own meta title, description and social image live in Pages › page settings › SEO, with their own unsaved-changes guard and their own Save. [design-ahead] The resolution is drawn nowhere: this screen does not say how many pages override the default, and the page field does not name the default it replaces.
structural.why: UX-I-41 (Major, duplicate-feature) — two editors for one output need to name each other. NEW in this pass: the settings module reported UX-I-41 as the one finding of its thirteen with no plan file at all, because it had neither a node id nor a matchable string. A band under the pane header needs neither.

structural.name: Open decision · rows that leave the app
structural.text: OPEN DECISION — rows that leave the app. This list mixes three destinations wearing one row shape: most rows drill into a form; Export drills in to reach a single button that opens the exporter elsewhere; Members and Billing are anchors that open the dashboard in a new tab. Proposed: a Destination=leaves-app variant of the shared Settings nav row — trailing ↗, no chevron — applied to Members and Billing only, and Export’s row opening the exporter directly. Drawn, not applied: the shared row is component set 2041:19572 with about 600 instances and this pass checked none of them.
structural.why: UX-I-39 (Minor, confusing-nav) — recorded as a drawn decision rather than a variant add, because adding a variant to 2041:19572 introduces a property dimension on every one of its ~600 instances and the brief requires listing every instance checked.
